name: Utah Cubing Fall Open 2009
information: The tournament begins at 9:30 AM. Pre-registration is $5 for the first event, plus $1 for each additional event. On-site registration is $10 for the first event, plus $2 for each additional event. Pizza and drinks will be provided for competitors. Non-competitors will have to pay $2 for food and drink. Pre-registration will be CLOSED Thursday, December 10th.  More information on the website.
